'''Eriquel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. He made his living by working as a crew skill trade vendor. Eriquel was of average height for a Human and had light tan skin with [[brown]] hair.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Eriquel first appeared as a vendor in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. The accompanying [[Prima Games]] guide, ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'', labeled him as "Eriq Donnel."
